en: Dependent on a state that is with refuge and with an object, there arises a state that is without refuge and without an object by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is without conflict and with an object, there arises a state that is without refuge and without an object by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Two under root; ... mutual, one; ... resultant, one; ... non-disappearance, two. (Abbreviated.)
